name: Reference check question plan
summary: After the interviews, the recruiter gets short reference calls aimed only at what the panel still could not establish, put to the referees the candidate named and agreed to, with a note sheet for each call that keeps the referee's own words. It gives no view on the candidate.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of recruiting work: the reference stage as one piece of work, started by a recruiter authorised to take references and ending with the hiring manager evaluating the answers. The method, defaults, rules, tests and worked example were written for this template.
